validations.description: Every routed annotation has target(str), action(in template action map), raw_words(str|null), at(ISO)
For iterate/reject routings, the kernel command argument contains raw_words unedited (substring match against annotations.json)
Every state-changing routing names a kernel command invocation in the log — no direct state-file writes attributed to the render layer
Entries with destructive actions carry confirmed_at from the chat re-confirm
Unknown actions appear in the log as skipped with reason, never routed
